name: design-craft
description: Turn Claude into an opinionated, accessibility-aware, AI-slop-resistant design collaborator that produces intentional design artifacts in HTML/CSS/SVG/JS — landing pages, interactive prototypes, mobile app screens, slide decks, wireframes, hi-fi variations, design-token extractions, and component inventories. The SKILL.md carries a full design philosophy (content discipline, purposeful aesthetics that reject AI-template tropes, visual hierarchy and rhythm, typography and color systems, interface copy as design material, WCAG accessibility, interaction states, system thinking, respecting the medium) and routes to 29 phased procedures across production (discovery-questions, frontend-aesthetic-direction, wireframe, make-a-deck, make-a-prototype, make-tweakable, generate-variations, make-an-animation, make-a-doc, generate-images), craft (motion-design, gsap-motion, depth-and-3d, laws-of-composition, typesetting, data-viz, mobile-design), system (design-system-extract, component-extract, design-system-author), and review (unit-critique-gate, accessibility-audit, ai-slop-check, hierarchy-rhythm-review, interaction-states-pass, visual-verification, polish-pass). Built for Claude Code: AskUserQuestion for kickoff rounds, the Agent tool for ship-time review panels over real deliverables, and self-contained deck-scaling / device-frame / tweak-panel code that runs as standalone files. v1.2 adds mobile-design (iOS/Material platform grammar, thumb zone, input methods, industry conventions, emotional design), gsap-motion (timelines, ScrollTrigger scroll storytelling, SplitText, SVG draw/morph, Flip/Draggable — all plugins free via CDN), visual-verification (viewport-matrix layout integrity + screenshot playbook, a fifth polish-pass reviewer), an interface-copy chapter, subject-derived aesthetics with a plan-time signature element and swap-test genericness gate, and detection for all three current AI-default looks (warm-editorial, dark+acid-accent, broadsheet). v1.3 wires in local design-system libraries (open-design DESIGN.md format: brand systems as binding context, library systems as direction candidates, deck-template styles for deck variety), portable 9-section DESIGN.md emission from design-system-extract/author plus signature-moves capture, accent budgets written as enforceable usage rules, Karpathy-style surgical iteration discipline, and an interface-copy lens in the polish-pass jury. v1.4 adds an agentic-iteration layer — unit-critique-gate (a mid-build per-unit draft→critique→repair loop with a canonical scores+mustFix rubric, convergence budgets, and a don't-double-loop rule for orchestrated harnesses), a deterministic design-lint script (stdlib Python, runs in any seeded sandbox), an autonomous mode for orchestrated/headless runs (assumptions instead of questions, iterate harder), and per-unit visual micro-checks with honest degradation when no browser exists — plus the typesetting and data-viz craft references and the ux-craft companion skill as a standing dependency for flows, forms, and UX review. v1.5 adds a redesign procedure (references/redesign.md: preserve/overhaul mode detection, audit-before-touching incl. SEO/analytics dependencies, a never-change-silently list, and modernisation levers in priority order), optical/cross-card alignment checks in hierarchy-rhythm-review, logo-wall sourcing (Simple Icons / SVG monograms, logos-only) and bento background-diversity rules in ai-slop-check, the double-bezel nested-enclosure technique in depth-and-3d, and a deliver-the-whole-count rule for multi-unit briefs — selected synthesis from the taste-skill corpus. v1.6 hardens verification into an epistemics rather than a checklist: visual-verification gains a Phase 0 verification contract (rendering a screenshot is not seeing one; ask each capture "what is wrong with this?" not "is this done?"; a gate is downstream of the findings that motivated it, so a clean lint means no known defect is present and never means verified; prove every new rule can fail by running it against the artifact that motivated it; coverage is silent because a selector matching nothing passes; crop to components at DPR 2-3 because a page thumbnail cannot resolve the defect; measure ink via a baseline probe plus canvas TextMetrics.actualBoundingBoxAscent rather than getBoundingClientRect boxes; and static checks are structurally blind to motion), a three-line report shape separating what a machine asserts from what you looked at from what you did not check, make-a-doc's print freeze reworked around the resting-style-is-final-style contract (invert the states when you own the CSS; the negative-delay skip is the fallback for stylesheets you don't), motion-design's review gaining the three-pass motion verification (print at rest, reduced-motion at rest, mid-flight frames) and an explicit z-index rule for transient overlays, and unit-critique-gate spelling out that a clean lint licenses one sentence and it is not "verified". v1.7 adds two render-breaking CSS mechanics to §15 that are invisible in source — cascade layers lose to any unlayered rule regardless of specificity (so `@layer` on a component makes it lose to an unlayered base reset, not win), and a sizing `height` attribute defeats CSS `aspect-ratio` and distorts the image (set `height:auto`) — plus a rendered-vs-natural aspect-ratio probe in visual-verification's Media check, and a mobile-header rule in mobile-design (collapse the action cluster to logo + one compact action + the menu toggle, or an overflowing cluster pushes the toggle off-screen and unreachable while a fixed-header page-overflow probe stays clean). v1.8 recalibrates the skill for current-model behaviour (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 prompting guidance): a Working-posture chapter fixes narration cadence (one line before the first tool call, updates only on findings or direction changes, outcome-first at the end), calibrates both output lengths (the reply and any written deliverable, including a length-is-part-of-the-design rule in make-a-doc and a standing end-of-file reminder), holds scope explicitly (concerns raised in a sentence, then build what was asked), limits correction narration to errors that change the user's decisions, and rewrites delegation from a default into an exception — verification is first-person (the value of a fresh reviewer is the question they bring, not the second context), unit-critique-gate's per-unit reviewer becomes self-critique in a deliberately separate pass with fan-out reserved for large or batched units, accessibility-audit's four agents and hierarchy-rhythm's two become checklists run in one pass, polish-pass sizes its panel to the deliverable and skips lenses whose subject isn't present, and the four make-a-deck / make-a-prototype / make-an-animation / depth-and-3d 'dispatch a verifier subagent' instructions become do-the-looking-yourself; agent briefs are now ordered artifact-first and task-last; the find-wide-then-filter rule is stated explicitly (a reviewer told to be conservative reports less, not better); the 'when unsure, run the review anyway' trigger is replaced with matching the trigger to what the artifact actually contains; discovery-questions front-loads every direction-changing question into one round because a complete brief left to run is the best condition to work in; multi-unit builds keep a resumable ledger instead of winding down early; visual-verification states that looking is cheaper than reasoning about what you'd see; and Space Grotesk joins Inter/Roboto/Arial/Fraunces as a banned silent default in SKILL.md §6, ai-slop-check, frontend-aesthetic-direction and design-lint.py — it is the face the model reaches for when *asked* to be distinctive, which makes it the opposite. v1.9 hands deck production to the new self-contained deck-craft skill: references/make-a-deck.md becomes a pointer and the router row redirects, so slides are owned by one skill spanning HTML, lecturn.deck/1 JSON/.pptx, and the 140-template Diolog investor library instead of a deck reference inside a general design skill. v1.10.0 imports the portable ideas from the impeccable skill: a visitor-mode taxonomy (Persuade / Operate / Read / Experience, chosen from the requested surface not the product) with a new references/visitor-modes.md carrying the Operate/Read depth that inverts the skill's Persuade-tuned defaults (earned familiarity, one type family, fixed rem scale not fluid, state-rich semantic vocabulary, a second neutral layer, structural responsive behaviour, no page-load choreography, and the permissions product surfaces are allowed) plus a matching polish-pass lens and discovery question; an anti-convergence direction procedure in frontend-aesthetic-direction (name the category's rut AND its predictable opposite before generating, derive seven candidates from the audience's cultural world including its graphic and screen traditions spanning at least three material families, and don't build your own top-ranked candidate because it is what every run would ship, plus a standing canon exit that is the user's door and never the recommendation); the five-block direction contract (THESIS / OWN-WORLD / STORY / FIRST VIEWPORT / FORM plus a FINISH line) written into the emitted markup so a build can't erase it, replacing the old token comment block, with the cream/paper/parchment rendition self-check on warm and bookish subjects; a comp-before-build phase (three comps at the surface's own viewport, one approval point, reproduction before enhancement, a written medium inventory, and the rule that the comp outranks every written record of it); the medium gate in generate-images (medium decided by what a region shows, never by what feels buildable: figures, objects, machinery and any named texture are raster whatever the stack, style doesn't move the boundary, authored SVG ends where drawing skill begins, and a field carries a written quantity commitment); review upgrades in unit-critique-gate and polish-pass (a computed disposition of ship/fix/rebuild reported verbatim, a rebuild directive when contradiction is the page rather than the exception because a patch list launders a rejection into an approval, a verdict pass scoring each repair resolved/partial/unresolved against the recapture since narration is not evidence, mandatory TYPE and MATERIAL rows, a first-unit hero checkpoint, fresh-never-forked reviewer contexts, the specificity judgment formed before reading deterministic findings, and a mandatory one-line disclosure for any degraded or skipped lens); the identity lock and default-vs-departure modes in generate-variations (one sentence of what is actually on screen in real values with no aesthetic-family label, six primary axes with three variants on three different axes, the squint test's family-pass-before-sentence-pass, and a per-intent differentiation table); a visual-weight-scaled knob budget in make-tweakable (leaf 0, small 0-1, medium 2, large 2-4, hard cap 4); browser surfaces as a first-class craft check (selection, caret, scrollbars, focus rings, underline offset, tabular numerals, the cheapest built-not-assembled signal); truth binds claims not demonstrations (author demonstration data at full fidelity and label it synthetic; commercial and factual claims stay uninventable; refusing a bold direction because its demo data doesn't exist yet is timidity wearing honesty's clothes); scope sovereignty (no new system primitive without asking) and the flat-section diagnosis (a flat section opted out of the system's own strongest moves); never-split-the-difference redesign semantics; a bounded verification ceiling (batched rounds, desktop and mobile together, fixes batched between rounds, stop when a round resolves nothing); and new bans for imitation material, hard offset block shadows, system display faces, glyph-as-icon, mono-as-costume and the reflex modal, alongside an explicit carve-out that the SVG ban targets pictures and never geometry.
